## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `dev`; this PR adds or changes one mod.
- [ ] `mods/<name>/patch.json` is generated by `mods/<name>/make_patch.py` (sources included); `name` = folder name.
- [ ] `mods/<name>/mod.json` (`title`, `kind`, `status`: `experimental` for a new mod, `summary`) and `mods/<name>/README.md` (use, how it works, tests, credits).
- [ ] `tests/test_<name>.py` runs the original OS code in the emulator; stored data survives save → reload.
- [ ] Shared resources claimed in `mods/<name>/claims.json`; `docs/registry.md` regenerated.
- [ ] No Elektron firmware bytes: no `.syx`, no extracted sections, no disassembly dumps.
- [ ] Sections 2 and 6 untouched; boot timing unchanged.
- [ ] `python tools/check_mod.py <name>` passes (patch reproducible, tests, build with every other mod, boot margin).
- [ ] `python -m pytest` and the web-builder tests pass. CI is green.
- [ ] Text follows `docs/writing-style.md`.
